description: This file defines the interface for the DobbyContainer management within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It provides declarations for the DobbyInterface class, which includes methods for container lifecycle operations (start, stop, pause, resume, etc.), container information retrieval, and event handling related to containers.

classes.name: DobbyInterface
classes.description: A class providing methods to manage and interact with containers via Dobby, including lifecycle management and event handling.

methods.name: DobbyInterface
methods.description: Constructor for DobbyInterface class.

methods.name: virtual ~DobbyInterface
methods.description: Virtual destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Dobby interface with an event handler.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the Dobby interface and cleans up resources.

methods.name: listContainers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of current container IDs.

methods.name: getContainerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific container.

methods.name: getContainerState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a container.

methods.name: startContainer
methods.description: Starts a new container with specified parameters.

methods.name: startContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container based on a Dobby specification.

methods.name: stopContainer
methods.description: Stops a running container.

methods.name: pauseContainer
methods.description: Pauses a container.

methods.name: resumeContainer
methods.description: Resumes a paused container.

methods.name: hibernateContainer
methods.description: Puts a container into hibernation mode.

methods.name: wakeupContainer
methods.description: Wakes up a hibernated container.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container.

methods.name: annotate
methods.description: Adds an annotation key-value pair to a container.

methods.name: removeAnnotation
methods.description: Removes an annotation key from a container.

methods.name: mount
methods.description: Mounts a filesystem source into a container.

methods.name: unmount
methods.description: Unmounts a filesystem from a container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Event callback for when a container starts.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Event callback for when a container stops.

methods.name: onContainerStateChanged
methods.description: Event callback for when a container's state changes.

methods.name: onVerityFailed
methods.description: Event callback for verification failures.

ctags.name: mEventListenerId
ctags.pattern: /^            int mEventListenerId; \/\/ Dobby event listener ID$/
